blocks.text: 业务函数接收 payload 与 Core context，简单返回值无需 context.success。两端同时开始连接，不能先 await 一端握手再启动另一端。单次调用 options.signal 负责该调用取消；timeoutMs 的 number / false 与零预算沿 Core 原有规则，工厂 defaultTimeoutMs 不能填 false 或 0。提供流方法不意味着任何网络载体都变得可靠，重试也不自动提供业务恰好一次保证。

Peer 来源是 {window,origin,receiver?,allowUnsafeTargetOrigin?}。window 是应用已持有的 iframe.contentWindow、window.parent、window.opener 或 window.open 返回值；origin 必填非空，不继承同源默认。receiver 缺省取具有 addEventListener 的当前全局对象；非 Window 宿主必须明确给接收者。origin='*' 仅在 allowUnsafeTargetOrigin===true 时允许；该选项省略值为 undefined，仍必须匹配指定窗口身份。

直接 createWindowMessageTransport({target,receiver?,targetOrigin?,allowUnsafeTargetOrigin?}) 的 target 必填；receiver 默认同上，targetOrigin 缺省取当前 location.origin，没有可用值时 INVALID_CONFIG。该默认与 Peer 的显式 origin 要求不同。发送调用 target.postMessage(message,targetOrigin,transfer)；transfer 默认 undefined，保留原生结构化克隆与转移语义。

sourceProof 仅接受 source===target 且 origin 匹配；显式通配符只放宽 origin。Peer bridge 在 ACK 和业务处理前使用它；Endpoint 用户把同一 transport 传给 connect。raw transport.subscribe 仍会收到未通过来源的记录，直接订阅者必须自行过滤，不能把收到了事件当作已验证。监听器挂在 receiver，发送者 target 与接收者可以不同。
导航、卸载和页面静默关闭没有通用可靠的远端关闭通知。新页面应重新建立 Peer，旧目录不能代表新页面身份；在途调用通常依赖已配置 deadline 结束，本地 pagehide 可主动 close。

sections.id: sharedworker-每个真实端口一个连接
sections.heading: SharedWorker：每个真实端口一个连接

blocks.text: 页面传 connect:{sharedWorker}，sharedWorker 只需暴露真实 port；可传原生 SharedWorker 或 {port}。端口要有 postMessage/addEventListener/removeEventListener，start 可选。createSharedWorkerTransport(port) 没有其他选项，topology 为 exclusive，发送保留 transfer 列表；首次业务订阅调用 start，并共享 message/messageerror 原生监听，最后一位退订后移除。端口仍由创建者关闭。

Worker 传 listen scope，其 addEventListener/removeEventListener 接收 'connect'，每个事件的 ports 是真实端口数组。每个端口独立握手、方法目录和在途调用；同一 scope 只能有一个活动监听器，重复绑定 LISTENER_ALREADY_BOUND，关闭原监听器后可重绑。listen 工厂完成表示接纳入口已安装，不表示已经有客户端握手。

监听器 close 先停止接纳，再清理已接纳 Peer 与尚在打开的资源，并保留同一个清理 Promise。没有客户端或有多个客户端时不能假定存在唯一调用目标。signal 取消加入同一关闭过程；没有提供 report 时，原 owner 报告不能从事件回调返回的失败。借用 scope 和端口不会被终止。对端静默 port.close 通常只能由 Core deadline 发现；messageerror 走载体错误通道。

createBroadcastChannelTransport(channel) 接受真实 BroadcastChannel，无额外选项；topology=broadcast、ownership=borrowed，不支持 transfer 列表。相同名字的频道向其它同域上下文广播，不是独占对端，也不是敏感数据的授权边界。多个提供方应使用唯一 Endpoint id/targetIds 选择逻辑目标。最后业务订阅移除只解绑原生 message 监听，不调用 channel.close。

createServiceWorkerTransport 的 target 与 receiver 必填：页面发送给实际 ServiceWorker，接收用 navigator.serviceWorker；Worker 发送给 clients.get 获得的实际 Client，接收用 self。peerId 可选，缺省 target.id。topology=multiplexed、ownership=borrowed，发送保留 transfer；不创建注册，也不维持后台进程。

Service Worker sourceProof 接受 target 本身，或 id===peerId 的来源。通过验证的跨 realm Client wrapper 被规范化为配置的 target；未验证来源仍按原记录交给 raw 订阅，connect 才按来源接纳。读取恶意 id 失败报告 TRANSPORT 并保留 cause，不变成可信来源。空闲终止后应用负责重建连接和持久化业务状态。

Peer 要求 ordered===true、maxRetransmits===null、maxPacketLifeTime===null；无序或有限重传以 RTC_CHANNEL_UNRELIABLE 拒绝。应用先完成 SDP/ICE 信令和连接；Peer 不创建或关闭原生频道。底层 createRtcDataChannelTransport(channel) 本身只检查公开方法与 readyState：open 可用，closed 构造为已终止；其它状态 INVALID_CONFIG。底层 adapter 不重复检查可靠性，不能因此把不可靠频道当成 Peer 支持契约。

RTC transport topology=exclusive、ownership=borrowed、encodedType='string'，非字符串发送值先 JSON.stringify。raw 订阅收到物理数据；Peer bridge 再 JSON.parse，解码失败 MESSAGE_DECODE_FAILED 且 cause 保留。closing/close/error 使 transport 终止，清理消息及终止监听并报告 TRANSPORT；后安装错误观察者可以看到终止原因。channel.close 与 RTCPeerConnection 仍归应用。

createWebTransportDatagramTransport({readable,writable}) 取得真实 datagram streams，topology=exclusive、ownership=owned、encodedType='uint8array'。构造即取得 writer，首次订阅启动 reader；退订业务回调不停止 reader。发送仅接受 Uint8Array，否则 TypeError/INVALID_CONFIG。仅选择字节 codec 并不足以得到可用 Endpoint：默认 framer 可能产出 unknown，native binary framer 可能产出 fragment 对象，均不满足此载体输入；本包未提供现成兼容的 Endpoint/framer 组合，因此这里不推荐一个未经验证的组合。send 返回经过拒绝分类的 Promise，不保证与 writer.write 返回对象同一引用。

EOF 或读取失败使 datagram transport 终止；close 共享同一 Promise，取消并等待 reader，尝试关闭 writer 和释放锁，保留所有清理失败。它拥有这两个 stream 端口，不拥有外部 WebTransport session；session.close 由应用负责。datagram 可丢失、乱序且受 MTU 限制，没有 Runtime Peer；deadline 只能结束等待，不能补回已丢失消息。

sections.heading: Endpoint 组合、生命周期与错误

blocks.text: adapter 返回 IRpcTransport，使用 createEndpoint({id,transport,middlewares:[connect({transport})]}) 组合；固定目标可加 targetIds。Endpoint.send(target,method,data,options?) 的 data 必填，无 payload 时传 null；provider 用 context.data / context.success / context.failed。需要业务版本或协议帧时，两端一致配置 contract({version}) / protocol()；Peer 已由 Core 配置其 Runtime 协议，不能把低层中间件重复配置当作 Peer 要求。

Window、SharedWorker、ServiceWorker、BroadcastChannel、RTC 都借用原生载体，Endpoint.dispose 与 Peer.close 释放订阅，创建者仍负责 close。WebTransport 只有其取得的 reader/writer 随 transport 释放。正常退订幂等；原生 remover 失败可能抛错并保留该登记，调用原 disposer 可再次尝试。不要声称所有清理都不失败。

blocks.text: 这些浏览器准入错误保留 TypeError 与 cause。握手、目录、业务调用、取消、超时及 wire 错误由 Core/Remote 拥有；旧 transport 配置错误为 Core INVALID_CONFIG。BroadcastChannel、SharedWorker、ServiceWorker 的原生发送失败，以及 WebTransport 的读写拒绝，由既有边界归类为 Core TRANSPORT：已有完整外包身份的 I/O Error 保留 source/code，可附身份的未分类原生 Error/DOMException 原位分类，不可附加的失败经 cause 保留。Window 与 RTC 的 raw send 直接委托原生发送，RTC 还可能直接抛出 JSON.stringify 错误，不能把上述分类概括到所有 raw send。监听失败与 RTC 终止事件沿各自报告通道保留原错误链；远端 source/code 不构成本地控制权限。
若调用一直超时，检查两端是否同时启动、固定 origin、真实来源窗口、目录及调用目标；Endpoint 还需核对 middleware 和 provide。未配有效等待上限时，不承诺及时发现静默断开。

所有六个 transport 支持 observe(probe)，Peer 的 probe 交给 Core，并经原 raw port.observe 转发。只有一个当前观察 slot；新登记替换旧登记，旧 disposer 不能清掉后来登记，即使复用同一个 probe。RTC 终止与 WebTransport 关闭释放观察者。探针失败走原 listener/report 通道，报告 TRANSPORT 并保留 cause，不改变业务和 sourceProof 路径。

每次物理发送及通过来源验证的接收同步 emit 一次。carrier 为 window/shared-worker/service-worker/broadcast-channel/rtc-data-channel/web-transport；不把被拒来源的载荷交给探针。detail 是复用对象，应立即消费或复制数值：origin 未知为空串，transfers 发送为列表长度、接收为 -1，rejectedSource 是自上次有效接收以来拒绝数，仅出现在下一次有效接收。

默认 capture 关闭，仅直接 byte backing/view 的 sizeBytes 可确定，字符串及容器为 -1。probe.capturing=true 时普通内容保留原引用；直接字节载荷的 backing buffer 确实在该次 transfer 中时，发送前复制将被 detach 的字节。嵌套 transferable 不遍历、不克隆，仍可能在原生转移后分离；不会为捕获执行 payload getter。Window/Worker/Broadcast 使用平台结构化克隆，RTC 使用物理 JSON 字符串，WebTransport 使用字节；Runtime payload 仍必须满足 Core 公共可移植值契约。

blocks.text: 输出为 `42`、`true`、`端口仍可用`：远端方法已执行，重复关闭复用同一 Promise，两个 Peer 关闭后原生端口仍能送达消息。
Node MessageChannel 提供 `connect.sharedWorker.port` 接受的真实端口操作；这里只证明端口路径，不代表浏览器 SharedWorker 宿主或窗口来源检查，最终由调用方关闭两个端口。

connect.sharedWorker.port 是 Node MessageChannel 的真实端口，满足公开结构，不是伪造的 SharedWorker；默认提供方法为空，service.provide.double 是接收 number 并返回 number 的方法，TRemote 只提供静态业务类型。两端用 Promise.all 同时开始握手；省略 defaultTimeoutMs 时为 30000 ms。close 复用同一 Promise，但不关闭端口；withResolvers 和原生 once 监听仅用于证明端口仍可用。

sections.id: 通过同一对端消费远端异步生成器
sections.heading: 通过同一对端消费远端异步生成器

blocks.text: 远端任务会陆续产生多个值，单次请求返回值却无法表达这一序列。
在远端先收齐结果会推迟消费，把生成器当普通方法调用又会丢掉迭代协议。
在远端类型中声明异步生成器，并使用 `stream`；每次取下一项都复用已经协商的端口连接。
输出：
完整消费通过原生端口传来的远端生成器后，输出 `3,4`。
`stream` 惰性启动，首次迭代才发送；单个结果使用 `request`。本例不证明浏览器信令、重连或跨窗口授权，两个端口仍由调用方拥有。
provide.values 是异步生成器，类型与远端 ISequenceApi 对应；start 参数为 3，产出 3、4。client.stream 使用方法名和 payload，未给调用选项时沿默认 30000 ms；for await 消费完毕，finally 释放两端逻辑连接与原生端口。没有模拟 Worker realm 或浏览器授权。

sections.id: 通过原生消息端口转移字节缓冲区
sections.heading: 通过原生消息端口转移字节缓冲区

blocks.text: 应用要显式转移一个缓冲区，需要清楚发送后哪一端还能使用其中的字节。
普通结构化克隆会保留副本，转移列表却会让发送端缓冲区分离；如果隐藏这个选择，后续读写就容易误用已经失效的缓冲区。
通过 `send(message, { transfer })` 传入实际缓冲区，适配器把列表交给原生端口，所有权变化遵循宿主的转移规则。
输出：
输出先是 `0`，然后是 `7,8`：发送端字节视图已分离，接收端取得原字节值。
`transfer` 默认 `undefined`，此时使用原生克隆。本例是原始载体收发，不是 RPC 载荷契约；调用方最终退订并关闭两个原生端口。

createSharedWorkerTransport 只接收真实 port；receiver.subscribe 的回调读取消息记录 data。send 的第二个参数 transfer 默认 undefined，本例显式放入 bytes.buffer，使用宿主转移而非复制；Uint8Array 初值 [7,8]，发送端 byteLength 随分离变 0。stop 只退订，物理端口最后单独关闭。

sections.id: 报告一个消息监听器的失败并继续交付其他监听器
sections.heading: 报告一个消息监听器的失败并继续交付其他监听器

blocks.text: 一个观察者处理消息时抛错，另一个观察者却仍需要收到这条消息。
用没有隔离的循环逐个调用监听器，首个异常就会中断交付，也可能让调用方不知道究竟哪个观察者失败。
在 `subscribe` 之外登记 `onListenerError`；载体通过监听器错误通道报告原异常，并继续分发同一条原生消息。
输出：

blocks.code:
已交付
1 true

blocks.text: 输出为 `已交付`、`1 true`：第二个订阅者收到消息，错误观察者恰好收到一次原异常。
这里隔离的是业务监听器失败，不代表原生端口故障可以继续工作；未登记错误观察者时，失败仍留在载体错误通道，清理操作可能再次呈现尚未处理的失败。
onListenerError 可选注册返回退订函数；reports 保存错误身份，failure 是本例唯一的业务观察异常。两个 subscribe 按注册顺序交付，第一位 throw 原错，第二位 resolve 实际 data；本例有错误观察者，不把失败留到清理时才发现。所有退订函数与端口均在 finally 释放。

sections.id: 把一条广播交付给两个频道参与者
sections.heading: 把一条广播交付给两个频道参与者

blocks.text: 多个参与者都需要同一条更新，而不是只选一个独占的远端接收方。
把共享频道当成私有对端，会忽略它的广播性质：其他符合宿主条件的参与者也能收到载荷。
为同名的原生 BroadcastChannel 分别创建载体；本例在 Node 中一次发送，两个已订阅接收者都会得到消息。
输出：
输出 `7,7`：两个原生频道参与者通过各自载体的订阅收到同一条更新。
这里只证明 Node 原生频道交付，不证明浏览器来源或存储分区准入。BroadcastChannel 不属于 `createBrowserPeer` 来源；端点标识可以选逻辑接收方，但不会把广播变成私有通信。
channel name 用 crypto.randomUUID 防止与别的运行混用，3 个真实 BroadcastChannel 实例使用同名；没有额外 adapter 选项。两个接收方各有一个 subscribe，Promise.all 保持结果登记顺序而不要求跨参与者到达顺序；发送数值 7，最终逐个关闭频道。

sections.id: 独立退订一个监听器并保留原生频道
sections.heading: 独立退订一个监听器并保留原生频道

blocks.text: 一个视图退出共享频道，另一个视图却仍要继续接收更新。
如果清理时一次移除全部监听器或直接关闭频道，就会截断尚未退订的其他使用者。
保存每次 `subscribe` 返回的退订函数；释放其中一个订阅不影响另一个，全部退订后也不会关闭调用方拥有的频道。
输出：

blocks.code:
0 第一条
原生消息

blocks.text: 输出 `0 第一条`、`原生消息`：已退订者没有运行，剩余订阅者收到第一条消息，最后退订后原生频道仍可交付消息。
监听移除成功后，重复退订不会再次移除；退订函数只释放此载体的登记，BroadcastChannel 实例仍须由应用关闭。
两个 subscribe 共享本 transport 的原生 message 监听，stopFirst 重复调用展示正常移除后的幂等；stopSecond 不受影响。全部退订后，原生 once:true 监听仍能从同一个频道收到消息；原生频道最后由应用 close。没有把广播变成独占对端。
根入口提供 createBrowserPeer、公共来源/选项类型，以及 RpcBrowserErrorCode、RPC_BROWSER_ERROR_SOURCE、IRpcBrowserErrorCode。Core 拥有握手、方法目录、调用、取消与错误传输；本包选择浏览器载体并复用它原有的消息路径。根入口按选中的载体延迟加载 adapter，不代表未经测量的体积或速度保证。

rows: 不支持，一对多不是固定对端
不支持，空闲终止会丢失内存连接

blocks.text: Dedicated Worker 与通用 MessagePort 的 transport 在 rpc-core 的 adapters/web-worker、adapters/message-port；由库创建并监督 Worker 时用 rpc-threads。进程通信由 rpc-process 负责。createBrowserPlugin 不存在，也没有 spawn、信令、自动重连监督、额外 Host slot 或跳过来源验证的开关。Node MessageChannel 案例使用真实端口满足 sharedWorker.port 的公开结构，不证明浏览器 SharedWorker 创建、跨源授权、RTC 信令或 WebTransport 网络行为。
安装同时显式声明 @migaia/rpc-browser 与其 peer 依赖 @migaia/rpc-core；依赖范围不构成运行时“版本必须相等”的检查。发布保留 dist 与 schema，以及根入口和六个 adapter 子入口。内部 browser 文件不是额外公开入口。

sections.heading: Runtime Peer 的参数与方法

blocks.text: `createBrowserPeer<TRemote>(options)` 返回 Core 的原始动态或类型化 Peer。TRemote 描述方法名、输入、结果和流类型，不授予来源信任或执行权限。必须恰好选择 connect 或 listen，不能传入已握手、已信任、已拥有的状态代替真实载体。

rows: window、sharedWorker、rtcDataChannel 三个来源恰选一个；无默认
实际 SharedWorker connect scope，与 connect 互斥；无默认
默认无业务方法；显式函数或嵌套 own-data 方法组，支持异步生成器；不执行配置 getter
缺省 name 为 browser，instanceId 由 Core 生成；身份说明不是授权凭据
默认 30000 ms，必须为正有限 number，可为小数；request/stream 继承此默认
默认无；连接时取消未完成握手，listen 模式持续监听并在取消时关闭监听器及其逻辑 Peer

默认 global=256、perPeer=64，由 Core 接纳并发提供方调用
默认无，可传一个或一组 Core probe；观察不改变协议和来源规则
可选的 Core 认证配置、显式高级方法模式/schema/幂等声明；默认不额外配置
保留 Core 的高级扩展入口，没有浏览器层另行生成的默认实现契约
等待远端标量结果；业务失败、取消、deadline 等使 Promise 拒绝

blocks.text: 业务函数接收 payload 与 Core context，简单返回值无需 context.success。两端同时开始连接，不能先 await 一端握手再启动另一端。单次调用 options.signal 负责该调用取消；timeoutMs 的 number / false 与零预算沿 Core 原有规则，工厂 defaultTimeoutMs 不能填 false 或 0。提供流方法不意味着任何网络载体都变得可靠，重试也不自动提供业务恰好一次保证。

Peer 来源是 {window,origin,receiver?,allowUnsafeTargetOrigin?}。window 是应用已持有的 iframe.contentWindow、window.parent、window.opener 或 window.open 返回值；origin 必填非空，不继承同源默认。receiver 缺省取具有 addEventListener 的当前全局对象；非 Window 宿主必须明确给接收者。origin='*' 仅在 allowUnsafeTargetOrigin===true 时允许；该选项省略值为 undefined，仍必须匹配指定窗口身份。

直接 createWindowMessageTransport({target,receiver?,targetOrigin?,allowUnsafeTargetOrigin?}) 的 target 必填；receiver 默认同上，targetOrigin 缺省取当前 location.origin，没有可用值时 INVALID_CONFIG。该默认与 Peer 的显式 origin 要求不同。发送调用 target.postMessage(message,targetOrigin,transfer)；transfer 默认 undefined，保留原生结构化克隆与转移语义。

sourceProof 仅接受 source===target 且 origin 匹配；显式通配符只放宽 origin。Peer bridge 在 ACK 和业务处理前使用它；Endpoint 用户把同一 transport 传给 connect。raw transport.subscribe 仍会收到未通过来源的记录，直接订阅者必须自行过滤，不能把收到了事件当作已验证。监听器挂在 receiver，发送者 target 与接收者可以不同。
导航、卸载和页面静默关闭没有通用可靠的远端关闭通知。新页面应重新建立 Peer，旧目录不能代表新页面身份；在途调用通常依赖已配置 deadline 结束，本地 pagehide 可主动 close。

sections.id: sharedworker-每个真实端口一个连接
sections.heading: SharedWorker：每个真实端口一个连接

blocks.text: 页面传 connect:{sharedWorker}，sharedWorker 只需暴露真实 port；可传原生 SharedWorker 或 {port}。端口要有 postMessage/addEventListener/removeEventListener，start 可选。createSharedWorkerTransport(port) 没有其他选项，topology 为 exclusive，发送保留 transfer 列表；首次业务订阅调用 start，并共享 message/messageerror 原生监听，最后一位退订后移除。端口仍由创建者关闭。

Worker 传 listen scope，其 addEventListener/removeEventListener 接收 'connect'，每个事件的 ports 是真实端口数组。每个端口独立握手、方法目录和在途调用；同一 scope 只能有一个活动监听器，重复绑定 LISTENER_ALREADY_BOUND，关闭原监听器后可重绑。listen 工厂完成表示接纳入口已安装，不表示已经有客户端握手。

监听器 close 先停止接纳，再清理已接纳 Peer 与尚在打开的资源，并保留同一个清理 Promise。没有客户端或有多个客户端时不能假定存在唯一调用目标。signal 取消加入同一关闭过程；没有提供 report 时，原 owner 报告不能从事件回调返回的失败。借用 scope 和端口不会被终止。对端静默 port.close 通常只能由 Core deadline 发现；messageerror 走载体错误通道。

createBroadcastChannelTransport(channel) 接受真实 BroadcastChannel，无额外选项；topology=broadcast、ownership=borrowed，不支持 transfer 列表。相同名字的频道向其它同域上下文广播，不是独占对端，也不是敏感数据的授权边界。多个提供方应使用唯一 Endpoint id/targetIds 选择逻辑目标。最后业务订阅移除只解绑原生 message 监听，不调用 channel.close。

createServiceWorkerTransport 的 target 与 receiver 必填：页面发送给实际 ServiceWorker，接收用 navigator.serviceWorker；Worker 发送给 clients.get 获得的实际 Client，接收用 self。peerId 可选，缺省 target.id。topology=multiplexed、ownership=borrowed，发送保留 transfer；不创建注册，也不维持后台进程。

Service Worker sourceProof 接受 target 本身，或 id===peerId 的来源。通过验证的跨 realm Client wrapper 被规范化为配置的 target；未验证来源仍按原记录交给 raw 订阅，connect 才按来源接纳。读取恶意 id 失败报告 TRANSPORT 并保留 cause，不变成可信来源。空闲终止后应用负责重建连接和持久化业务状态。

Peer 要求 ordered===true、maxRetransmits===null、maxPacketLifeTime===null；无序或有限重传以 RTC_CHANNEL_UNRELIABLE 拒绝。应用先完成 SDP/ICE 信令和连接；Peer 不创建或关闭原生频道。底层 createRtcDataChannelTransport(channel) 本身只检查公开方法与 readyState：open 可用，closed 构造为已终止；其它状态 INVALID_CONFIG。底层 adapter 不重复检查可靠性，不能因此把不可靠频道当成 Peer 支持契约。

RTC transport topology=exclusive、ownership=borrowed、encodedType='string'，非字符串发送值先 JSON.stringify。raw 订阅收到物理数据；Peer bridge 再 JSON.parse，解码失败 MESSAGE_DECODE_FAILED 且 cause 保留。closing/close/error 使 transport 终止，清理消息及终止监听并报告 TRANSPORT；后安装错误观察者可以看到终止原因。channel.close 与 RTCPeerConnection 仍归应用。

createWebTransportDatagramTransport({readable,writable}) 取得真实 datagram streams，topology=exclusive、ownership=owned、encodedType='uint8array'。构造即取得 writer，首次订阅启动 reader；退订业务回调不停止 reader。发送仅接受 Uint8Array，否则 TypeError/INVALID_CONFIG。仅选择字节 codec 并不足以得到可用 Endpoint：默认 framer 可能产出 unknown，native binary framer 可能产出 fragment 对象，均不满足此载体输入；本包未提供现成兼容的 Endpoint/framer 组合，因此这里不推荐一个未经验证的组合。send 返回经过拒绝分类的 Promise，不保证与 writer.write 返回对象同一引用。

EOF 或读取失败使 datagram transport 终止；close 共享同一 Promise，取消并等待 reader，尝试关闭 writer 和释放锁，保留所有清理失败。它拥有这两个 stream 端口，不拥有外部 WebTransport session；session.close 由应用负责。datagram 可丢失、乱序且受 MTU 限制，没有 Runtime Peer；deadline 只能结束等待，不能补回已丢失消息。

sections.heading: Endpoint 组合、生命周期与错误

blocks.text: adapter 返回 IRpcTransport，使用 createEndpoint({id,transport,middlewares:[connect({transport})]}) 组合；固定目标可加 targetIds。Endpoint.send(target,method,data,options?) 的 data 必填，无 payload 时传 null；provider 用 context.data / context.success / context.failed。需要业务版本或协议帧时，两端一致配置 contract({version}) / protocol()；Peer 已由 Core 配置其 Runtime 协议，不能把低层中间件重复配置当作 Peer 要求。

Window、SharedWorker、ServiceWorker、BroadcastChannel、RTC 都借用原生载体，Endpoint.dispose 与 Peer.close 释放订阅，创建者仍负责 close。WebTransport 只有其取得的 reader/writer 随 transport 释放。正常退订幂等；原生 remover 失败可能抛错并保留该登记，调用原 disposer 可再次尝试。不要声称所有清理都不失败。

rows: Window Peer 缺少非空 origin；填写明确对端源
Peer 的频道不是可靠有序；改用受支持配置
SharedWorker scope 已有监听器；先关闭旧监听器
connect/listen 冲突或来源不支持；恰选一个真实来源
Peer 的 RTC JSON 无法解码；检查对端物理输入，cause 保留解码原错

blocks.text: 这些浏览器准入错误保留 TypeError 与 cause。握手、目录、业务调用、取消、超时及 wire 错误由 Core/Remote 拥有；旧 transport 配置错误为 Core INVALID_CONFIG。BroadcastChannel、SharedWorker、ServiceWorker 的原生发送失败，以及 WebTransport 的读写拒绝，由既有边界归类为 Core TRANSPORT：已有完整外包身份的 I/O Error 保留 source/code，可附身份的未分类原生 Error/DOMException 原位分类，不可附加的失败经 cause 保留。Window 与 RTC 的 raw send 直接委托原生发送，RTC 还可能直接抛出 JSON.stringify 错误，不能把上述分类概括到所有 raw send。监听失败与 RTC 终止事件沿各自报告通道保留原错误链；远端 source/code 不构成本地控制权限。
若调用一直超时，检查两端是否同时启动、固定 origin、真实来源窗口、目录及调用目标；Endpoint 还需核对 middleware 和 provide。未配有效等待上限时，不承诺及时发现静默断开。

每次物理发送及通过来源验证的接收同步 emit 一次。carrier 为 window/shared-worker/service-worker/broadcast-channel/rtc-data-channel/web-transport；不把被拒来源的载荷交给探针。detail 是复用对象，应立即消费或复制数值：origin 未知为空串，transfers 发送为列表长度、接收为 -1，rejectedSource 是自上次有效接收以来拒绝数，仅出现在下一次有效接收。

sections.heading: Window: a specific window and origin

blocks.text: The Peer source is {window,origin,receiver?,allowUnsafeTargetOrigin?}. window is an application-owned iframe.contentWindow, window.parent, window.opener, or window.open result. origin is required and nonempty; it has no same-origin default. receiver defaults to the current global object when addEventListener is available; a non-Window host must supply the receiver explicitly. origin='*' requires allowUnsafeTargetOrigin===true; omission is undefined, and the selected window identity is still checked.

Direct createWindowMessageTransport({target,receiver?,targetOrigin?,allowUnsafeTargetOrigin?}) requires target. receiver uses the same default, while targetOrigin defaults to the current location.origin and fails with INVALID_CONFIG when unavailable. That compatibility default does not apply to the Peer's origin. Sending invokes target.postMessage(message,targetOrigin,transfer); transfer defaults to undefined and keeps native structured-clone and transfer semantics.

sourceProof accepts only source===target with a matching origin; the explicit wildcard relaxes only the origin match. The Peer bridge uses it before ACK capture and business handling. Endpoint users pass the same transport to connect. Raw transport.subscribe still receives rejected-source records, so direct subscribers must filter them rather than treating event delivery as verification. Listeners attach to receiver, which may differ from the outbound target.

sections.heading: SharedWorker: one connection per real port

blocks.text: A page passes connect:{sharedWorker}. sharedWorker only needs a real port, so a native SharedWorker or {port} is accepted. The port requires postMessage/addEventListener/removeEventListener; start is optional. createSharedWorkerTransport(port) has no other options and has exclusive topology. Sends retain transfer lists. The first business subscription calls start and installs shared message/messageerror listeners; the last unsubscribe removes them. The creator still closes the port.

A worker passes its real listen scope, whose addEventListener/removeEventListener handle 'connect' events with real ports arrays. Each port has an independent handshake, catalog, and pending calls. Only one listener may bind a scope at a time; a second fails with LISTENER_ALREADY_BOUND until the first closes. Resolving a listen factory means acceptance is installed, not that a client has handshaken.

Listener close first stops acceptance, then cleans admitted Peers and resources still opening, preserving one cleanup Promise. Do not assume a unique request target when zero or several clients are connected. signal cancellation joins that same cleanup. Without report, the original owner reports failures that cannot be returned from a native callback. Borrowed scopes and ports are never terminated. A remote silent port.close normally becomes visible through Core deadlines; messageerror uses the carrier error channel.

createBroadcastChannelTransport(channel) takes a real BroadcastChannel and no extra options. It has topology=broadcast and ownership=borrowed, with no transfer list. Matching channel names broadcast to other same-origin contexts rather than an exclusive peer or an authorization boundary for sensitive data. Use unique Endpoint ids/targetIds to select logical providers. Removing the final business subscription only detaches the native message listener; it does not call channel.close.

createServiceWorkerTransport requires target and receiver. In a page, send to a real ServiceWorker and receive through navigator.serviceWorker. In a worker, send to a real Client obtained from clients.get and receive through self. Optional peerId defaults to target.id. The transport is multiplexed and borrowed, preserves send transfer lists, and neither creates registrations nor keeps background processes alive.

Service Worker sourceProof accepts target itself or a source whose id===peerId. A verified cross-realm Client wrapper is normalized to the configured target. Unverified sources still reach raw subscribers unchanged; connect performs admission. A hostile id read reports TRANSPORT with its cause and does not manufacture a trusted source. The application owns reconnection and persistent business state after idle termination.

A Peer requires ordered===true, maxRetransmits===null, and maxPacketLifeTime===null. Unordered or partially reliable channels fail with RTC_CHANNEL_UNRELIABLE. The application establishes SDP/ICE signaling and the connection first; the Peer neither creates nor closes the native channel. Lower-level createRtcDataChannelTransport(channel) checks the public operations and readyState: open is usable, closed constructs an already-terminal transport, and other states fail with INVALID_CONFIG. The lower adapter does not repeat reliability checks, which does not expand the Peer's supported carrier contract.

RTC transport has topology=exclusive, ownership=borrowed, and encodedType='string'. Non-string sends use JSON.stringify. Raw subscribers receive physical data; the Peer bridge subsequently JSON.parse decodes it, reporting MESSAGE_DECODE_FAILED with the original decoder cause. closing/close/error terminates the transport, removes message/terminal listeners, and reports TRANSPORT. Later error observers can see the terminal reason. The application retains channel.close and RTCPeerConnection ownership.

createWebTransportDatagramTransport({readable,writable}) receives real datagram streams and has topology=exclusive, ownership=owned, encodedType='uint8array'. Construction acquires the writer; the first subscription starts the reader. Business unsubscribe does not stop the reader. Sending requires Uint8Array, otherwise TypeError/INVALID_CONFIG. A bytes codec alone is insufficient for an Endpoint: the default framer may output unknown values and native binary framing may output fragment objects, which this carrier rejects. This module supplies no ready-made compatible Endpoint/framer recipe. send returns a rejection-classifying Promise and does not preserve writer.write Promise identity.

EOF or read failure terminates the datagram transport. close shares one Promise, cancels and joins the reader, attempts writer closure and lock release, and preserves cleanup failures. It owns those stream ports, not the external WebTransport session; the application still calls session.close. Datagram loss, reordering, and MTU limits exclude Runtime Peer support. A deadline can end waiting but cannot recover lost messages.

An adapter returns IRpcTransport for createEndpoint({id,transport,middlewares:[connect({transport})]}), optionally with targetIds. Endpoint.send(target,method,data,options?) requires data; pass null when there is no payload. Providers use context.data / context.success / context.failed. For business versions or protocol frames, configure contract({version}) / protocol() consistently at both ends. Core already configures the Runtime protocol for Peer; do not treat duplicate low-level middleware configuration as a Peer requirement.

Window, SharedWorker, ServiceWorker, BroadcastChannel, and RTC borrow their native carriers. Endpoint.dispose and Peer.close release subscriptions while the creator retains physical close ownership. WebTransport releases only its acquired reader/writer. Normal unsubscribe is idempotent. Native remover failure may throw while retaining the registration, allowing the original disposer to retry; cleanup is not guaranteed to be infallible.

A worker passes its real listen scope, whose addEventListener/removeEventListener handle 'connect' events with real ports arrays. Each port has an independent handshake, catalog, and pending calls. Only one listener may bind a scope at a time; a second fails with LISTENER_ALREADY_BOUND until the first closes. Resolving a listen factory means acceptance is installed, not that a client has handshaken.

Listener close first stops acceptance, then cleans admitted Peers and resources still opening, preserving one cleanup Promise. Do not assume a unique request target when zero or several clients are connected. signal cancellation joins that same cleanup. Without report, the original owner reports failures that cannot be returned from a native callback. Borrowed scopes and ports are never terminated. A remote silent port.close normally becomes visible through Core deadlines; messageerror uses the carrier error channel.

createBroadcastChannelTransport(channel) takes a real BroadcastChannel and no extra options. It has topology=broadcast and ownership=borrowed, with no transfer list. Matching channel names broadcast to other same-origin contexts rather than an exclusive peer or an authorization boundary for sensitive data. Use unique Endpoint ids/targetIds to select logical providers. Removing the final business subscription only detaches the native message listener; it does not call channel.close.

createServiceWorkerTransport requires target and receiver. In a page, send to a real ServiceWorker and receive through navigator.serviceWorker. In a worker, send to a real Client obtained from clients.get and receive through self. Optional peerId defaults to target.id. The transport is multiplexed and borrowed, preserves send transfer lists, and neither creates registrations nor keeps background processes alive.

Service Worker sourceProof accepts target itself or a source whose id===peerId. A verified cross-realm Client wrapper is normalized to the configured target. Unverified sources still reach raw subscribers unchanged; connect performs admission. A hostile id read reports TRANSPORT with its cause and does not manufacture a trusted source. The application owns reconnection and persistent business state after idle termination.

A Peer requires ordered===true, maxRetransmits===null, and maxPacketLifeTime===null. Unordered or partially reliable channels fail with RTC_CHANNEL_UNRELIABLE. The application establishes SDP/ICE signaling and the connection first; the Peer neither creates nor closes the native channel. Lower-level createRtcDataChannelTransport(channel) checks the public operations and readyState: open is usable, closed constructs an already-terminal transport, and other states fail with INVALID_CONFIG. The lower adapter does not repeat reliability checks, which does not expand the Peer's supported carrier contract.

RTC transport has topology=exclusive, ownership=borrowed, and encodedType='string'. Non-string sends use JSON.stringify. Raw subscribers receive physical data; the Peer bridge subsequently JSON.parse decodes it, reporting MESSAGE_DECODE_FAILED with the original decoder cause. closing/close/error terminates the transport, removes message/terminal listeners, and reports TRANSPORT. Later error observers can see the terminal reason. The application retains channel.close and RTCPeerConnection ownership.

createWebTransportDatagramTransport({readable,writable}) receives real datagram streams and has topology=exclusive, ownership=owned, encodedType='uint8array'. Construction acquires the writer; the first subscription starts the reader. Business unsubscribe does not stop the reader. Sending requires Uint8Array, otherwise TypeError/INVALID_CONFIG. A bytes codec alone is insufficient for an Endpoint: the default framer may output unknown values and native binary framing may output fragment objects, which this carrier rejects. This module supplies no ready-made compatible Endpoint/framer recipe. send returns a rejection-classifying Promise and does not preserve writer.write Promise identity.

EOF or read failure terminates the datagram transport. close shares one Promise, cancels and joins the reader, attempts writer closure and lock release, and preserves cleanup failures. It owns those stream ports, not the external WebTransport session; the application still calls session.close. Datagram loss, reordering, and MTU limits exclude Runtime Peer support. A deadline can end waiting but cannot recover lost messages.

An adapter returns IRpcTransport for createEndpoint({id,transport,middlewares:[connect({transport})]}), optionally with targetIds. Endpoint.send(target,method,data,options?) requires data; pass null when there is no payload. Providers use context.data / context.success / context.failed. For business versions or protocol frames, configure contract({version}) / protocol() consistently at both ends. Core already configures the Runtime protocol for Peer; do not treat duplicate low-level middleware configuration as a Peer requirement.

Window, SharedWorker, ServiceWorker, BroadcastChannel, and RTC borrow their native carriers. Endpoint.dispose and Peer.close release subscriptions while the creator retains physical close ownership. WebTransport releases only its acquired reader/writer. Normal unsubscribe is idempotent. Native remover failure may throw while retaining the registration, allowing the original disposer to retry; cleanup is not guaranteed to be infallible.

A Peer channel is not ordered and reliable; use supported settings
A SharedWorker scope already has a listener; close it first
Conflicting connect/listen or unsupported sources; choose one real source
The Peer cannot decode RTC JSON; inspect physical input, with the original decoder on cause

blocks.text: Browser admission errors retain TypeError and cause. Core/Remote own handshake, catalog, business call, cancellation, timeout, and wire errors; existing transport configuration failures use Core INVALID_CONFIG. Native send failures in BroadcastChannel, SharedWorker, and ServiceWorker, plus WebTransport read/write rejections, use the existing Core TRANSPORT boundary: complete foreign I/O identity is retained, attachable unclassified Error/DOMException values are classified in place, and non-attachable failures remain reachable through cause. Window and RTC raw sends delegate directly to native sending, and RTC may also throw from JSON.stringify; this classification therefore does not apply to every raw send. Listener failures and RTC terminal events retain their original error chains through their respective report channels. Remote diagnostic source/code is not local control authority.

For persistent timeouts, check simultaneous startup, explicit origin, the real source window, catalog, and target; Endpoint users should also inspect middleware and provide. Without an effective waiting limit, silent disconnection is not guaranteed to be detected promptly.

All six transports support observe(probe). Peer passes its probe to Core and forwards observation through the existing raw port.observe. There is one current observation slot: a new registration replaces the old one, and an older disposer cannot clear a successor even when both reuse one probe object. RTC termination and WebTransport closure release observers. Probe failures use the original listener/report channel with TRANSPORT and cause, without changing business delivery or sourceProof.

Each physical send and source-verified receive emits synchronously once. carrier is window/shared-worker/service-worker/broadcast-channel/rtc-data-channel/web-transport. Rejected-source payloads are not exposed to the probe. detail is reused, so consume it immediately or copy values: unknown origin is an empty string, transfers is the send-list length or -1 on receive, and rejectedSource counts rejections since the preceding valid receive, appearing only on the next valid receive.

Capture is off by default. Only direct byte backing/view sizes are known; strings and containers have sizeBytes=-1. With probe.capturing=true, ordinary content retains its original reference. When a direct byte payload's backing buffer is actually transferred, those bytes are copied before native detachment. Nested transferables are not traversed or cloned and may detach after transfer; capture does not execute payload getters. Window/Worker/Broadcast use platform structured cloning, RTC uses physical JSON strings, and WebTransport uses bytes. Runtime payloads still obey Core's public portable-value contract.
